name: io.github.SarutobiSasuke8/jobscout-mcp
title: JobScout MCP
description: Multi-source job discovery, deduplication and AI/Web3 classification for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSCOUT_ENABLE_HIMALAYAS
environmentVariables.description: Enable the public Himalayas remote MCP search adapter.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSCOUT_ENABLE_WEWORKREMOTELY
environmentVariables.description: Enable the public We Work Remotely RSS adapter.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSCOUT_ENABLE_REMOTEOK
environmentVariables.description: Enable the public RemoteOK JSON adapter.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSCOUT_ENABLE_GREENHOUSE
environmentVariables.description: Enable the official Greenhouse public job-board adapter (needs GREENHOUSE_BOARDS).

environmentVariables.name: GREENHOUSE_BOARDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Greenhouse board tokens, each token or token=Company Name.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSCOUT_ENABLE_ASHBY
environmentVariables.description: Enable the official Ashby public job-board adapter (needs ASHBY_BOARDS).

environmentVariables.name: ASHBY_BOARDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Ashby job-board names, each token or token=Company Name.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSCOUT_ENABLE_LEVER
environmentVariables.description: Enable the official Lever public postings adapter (needs LEVER_SITES).

environmentVariables.name: LEVER_SITES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Lever site names, each token or token=Company Name.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSCOUT_ENABLE_JOBSPY
environmentVariables.description: Enable the optional local python-jobspy bridge.

environmentVariables.name: JOBSPY_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Python executable used for the optional JobSpy bridge.
